In the first lesson you learned to *go*, *come* and *return*. Now you learn how to point the way — left, right, straight ahead — and how to place things in space: inside, outside, behind, in front. All of these still take the same بـ / هـ / ending system from lesson 1.

## More movement verbs

A handful more, in their dictionary (he-past) and present (he-) forms.

| Past (هو) - franco | Present (هو) - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| مشي - meshi | بيمشي - biyimshi | to walk / to set off |
| سافر - safer | بيسافر - biyisafer | to travel |
| وصل - wesel | بيوصل - biyiwsal | to arrive |
| خرج - 5arag | بيخرج - biyo5rog | to go out |
| دخل - da5al | بيدخل - biyed5ol | to go in / enter |
| نزل - nezel | بينزل - biyinzel | to go down / get off |
| طلع - tele3 | بيطلع - biyitla3 | to go up / come up |
| لف - laff | بيلف - biyliff | to turn / go around |

## Directions

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| يمين - yemeen | right |
| شمال - shimal | left |
| على طول - 3ala tool | straight ahead |
| لف يمين - leff yemeen | turn right (to a man) |
| لفي يمين - leffi yemeen | turn right (to a woman) |
| لف شمال - leff shimal | turn left (to a man) |
| لفي شمال - leffi shimal | turn left (to a woman) |
| قبل - 2abl | before |
| بعد - ba3d | after |

## Place complements

These say *where* something is. Most pair with a noun directly: *2oddam el-bet* = "in front of the house".

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| جنب - ganb | next to / beside |
| قدام - 2oddam | in front of |
| ورا - wara | behind |
| بين - ben | between |
| جوه - guwwa | inside |
| بره - barra | outside |
| فوق - fo2 | up / above / upstairs |
| تحت - ta7t | down / below / downstairs |

<details class="frase">
<summary>العربية قدام البيت</summary>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya 2oddam el-bet</span>
<span class="en">the car is in front of the house</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>المطعم جنب الجامع</summary>
<span class="fr">el-mat3am ganb el-game3</span>
<span class="en">the restaurant is next to the mosque</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>إحنا فوق، إنت تحت</summary>
<span class="fr">e7na fo2, inta ta7t</span>
<span class="en">we're upstairs, you're downstairs</span>
</details>

## Dialogue: getting directions

Layla is on her way to Hassan's place and calls for directions.

<span class="rotulo">حسن — Hassan</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>إنتي فين دلوقتي؟</summary>
<span class="fr">inti feen delwa2ti?</span>
<span class="en">Where are you now?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ليلى — Layla</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا جاية، أنا قريب من بيتك</summary>
<span class="fr">ana gayya, ana 2orayyeb men betak</span>
<span class="en">I'm on my way, I'm near your place</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">حسن — Hassan</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>تمام! لفي يمين، البيت على إيدك الشمال</summary>
<span class="fr">tamam! leffi yemeen, el-bet 3ala eedek esh-shimal</span>
<span class="en">Great! Turn right, the house is on your left</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ليلى — Layla</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أشوف عمارة كبيرة قدامي</summary>
<span class="fr">ashoof 3emara kbeera 2oddami</span>
<span class="en">I see a big building in front of me</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">حسن — Hassan</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، إحنا فوق، الدور التالت</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, e7na fo2, ed-dor et-talet</span>
<span class="en">Yes, we're upstairs, the third floor</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ليلى — Layla</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>ماشي، أنا طالعة دلوقتي</summary>
<span class="fr">mashi, ana tal3a delwa2ti</span>
<span class="en">OK, I'm coming up now</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">حسن — Hassan</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>هتوصلي امتى؟</summary>
<span class="fr">hatiwsali emta?</span>
<span class="en">When will you arrive?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ليلى — Layla</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بعد شوية، خمس دقايق</summary>
<span class="fr">ba3d shuwayya, 5amas da2aye2</span>
<span class="en">In a bit, five minutes</span>
</details>

### Exercise 2 — Translate into Arabic

**1.** Turn right, the school is on your left.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">لف يمين، المدرسة على إيدك الشمال</span>
<span class="fr">leff yemeen, el-madrasa 3ala eedak esh-shimal</span>
</details>

**2.** Go straight ahead.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">امشي على طول</span>
<span class="fr">emshi 3ala tool</span>
</details>

**3.** The car is in front of the building.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">العربية قدام العمارة</span>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya 2oddam el-3emara</span>
</details>

**4.** I'll go up to the third floor.

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">أنا هطلع الدور التالت</span>
<span class="fr">ana hatla3 ed-dor et-talet</span>
</details>

### Exercise 3 — Reading comprehension

Answer from the dialogue above.

**1.** Which way does Layla turn?

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="en">Right — *leffi yemeen*; the house is then on her left.</span>
</details>

**2.** Which floor is Hassan on?

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="en">The third floor — *ed-dor et-talet*.</span>
</details>

**3.** How long until Layla arrives?

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="en">About five minutes — *ba3d shuwayya, 5amas da2aye2*.</span>
</details>
